name: ポラーラ -Polara-
description:
``Polara'' features the main character, Lala, who keeps running forward while changing the color of her protective suit.
Run through a city surrounded by defense systems,
"Color change speed run action".

Attacks from defense systems can be prevented by matching the color of defense clothing.
You can pass safely.
On the other hand, if the colors are different, it will be destroyed.

The only operations you need to do are "jump" and "change". But it's hot.

Simple, but not easy.
This is a new type of speed run action.
